## Post-deploy validation findings (preliminary)

Deploy verification (AC1): Qwen3 llama-server confirmed running with
--cache-ram 40960, --swa-checkpoints 32, no --swa-full ✓

Post-deploy data available: llama-server.log created 2026-10-15 00:41 UTC,
current time ~01:36 UTC — ~55 minutes of data, 50 requests.

Comparison table (32,768 MiB baseline → 40,960 MiB partial):

| Metric | 32,768 MiB (1,404 req) | 40,960 MiB (50 req) | Change |
|--------|------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Evictions | 18 | 0 | ✓ eliminated |
| Cache saturated samples | 67 (26.27%) | 0 (0.0%) | ✓ eliminated |
| Cache peak (MiB) | 32,765.6 | 5,651.2 | ✓ well under cap |
| Forced full prefills | 68 (4.8% of reqs) | 5 (10.0% of reqs) | ⚠ higher % (small n) |
| Prompt eval tok/s median | 77.3 | 131.6 | ✓ improved |
| Decode tok/s median | 18.4 | 26.0 | ✓ improved |
| First byte ms median | 8,046.3 | 8,106.7 | ✓ comparable |
| Cache prompts max (held) | 16 | 6 | ✓ fewer held prompts |

Recommendation: only 20,480 MiB needed for this workload — 40,960 MiB
provides ample headroom. No further increase required.

Artifact saved: docs/dev/prompt-cache-post-deploy-2026-10-15-partial.json

⚠ AC2/AC5/AC6 need full ~4.7-day window (1,404+ requests) for definitive
comparison. Partial data strongly suggests positive impact. Waiting for
full measurement window.
